findings.subject: OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and OpenClaw safety comparison
findings.statement: OpenAI Agents SDK and Google ADK have higher safety adherence than OpenClaw across tool use, resource access, and information flow in Figure 8.
qualitative_ranking: OpenAI Agents SDK and Google ADK are above OpenClaw on all three stated safety channels.
findings.search_scope: Paper text, Figure 8, experimental setup, and framework adapter appendix
limitations: Exact Figure 8 values are graphical and are not tabulated in the paper text.
The framework comparison covers only five matched tasks.
The paper compares OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and OpenClaw, not Microsoft Agent Framework.

findings.subject: Governed intelligence and reuse dimensions
findings.statement: None of the reviewed published comparisons measures a governed four-layer intelligence bank, cold-to-warm reuse, candidate promotion, or user-guidance retrieval.
findings.source_title: Focused cross-source published harness evidence review
findings.search_scope: Numeric result pages, graphical safety paper, official project evaluation pages, and the current Loop Engine repository
limitations: This finding is limited to the reviewed sources and is not a claim about every benchmark or paper.
The missing dimension is an evaluation gap, not evidence that Loop Engine is better.
